conditionDescription: Only in counties where LegalEase has collected and approved the current local petition and order set. No county qualifies yet.

draftingProhibited.reason: This unit requires a mandatory official form. There is no statewide Judicial Council form for a Cal. Penal Code § 851.90 sealing; each county publishes its own petition and order. Drafting a substitute petition or order here would invent a court form, a caption, a venue, and filing mechanics that no source states. No pleading is drafted for this unit.

officialForms.name: Superior Court of California, County of San Diego, local criminal form SDSC CRM-307
officialForms.sha256Note: No SHA-256 recorded for this source, so staleness cannot be detected (counsel flag cf-09).
officialForms.inventoryNote: Not present in the CA state pack officialFormInventory or resourcePacketInventory. The only inventoried CA PDF is California-Expungement-RecordRelief-Agent-Reference.pdf; the inventoried HTML references are ca-dismissal-sealing-forms.html, CR-180.html, CR-181.html and find-forms.html, none of which is this form.

officialForms.name: Kern County local § 851.90 petition and order set
officialForms.inventoryNote: The registry records that Kern County publishes its own local petition but gives it no form number and no URL. Nothing further may be stated about it.

owningLane.scope: Official-form acquisition and approval: collect the current local petition and order set for each supported county, record a SHA-256, and route it through form approval.
owningLane.handoffScope: Local-form survey across the remaining California target counties. The registry records that no survey of local forms in the target counties has been done.

blockedDependency: Lane D official-form acquisition — San Diego local form SDSC CRM-307 and the Kern County local § 851.90 petition and order set; plus a lane-E survey of local forms in the remaining target counties. Registry buildBlockers[2] and legalDesignLimitations[1] retain this as a true blocker.

blockingSource.unavailableReason: No approved local petition and order set has been sourced for any county. County-specific form and filing coverage is a retained blocker, and it is a scope restriction on which counties are supported rather than a reason to suppress the guidance unit.
blockingSource.sourceHeading: California operational amendments / True blockers retained
blockingSource.sourceStatement: County-specific form and filing coverage for CA-10 where no approved local set has been sourced.

participantTreatmentWhileBlocked.instruction: The participant obtains the county's own petition and order forms from the county superior court clerk or self-help centre and asks which local form applies to a § 851.90 sealing. LegalEase selects no form and prefills no field.

manualCompletion.whereInPacket: The county's own petition, signature block
manualCompletion.why: The petitioner signs their own petition.
